Destination not in the list? Request a quote on WhatsApp

Weight and size are per piece. Each piece is billed at the higher of actual weight and L × W × H / 5000, rounded up to 0.5 kg. Final charges follow weighing and measuring.

Shipper (you)

Economy pickup outside Jakarta is arranged by request.
WhatsAppEmail
Or choose Drop-off, or PCW Priority Express (pickup anywhere).

Receiver

The receiver’s email and phone are needed for delivery updates and customs. PO Box addresses cannot be delivered.

Be specific: customs may hold vague descriptions such as “gift” or “goods”. Gifts are treated as commercial shipments.

Extras are requests: our team confirms availability and price for your destination before shipping.

The price is recalculated from our published rates; our team confirms the final price after weighing, then issues your AWB. Guest and Personal bookings are paid upfront by bank transfer; we process the shipment only after payment is received.
